mode.title: Search mode
mode.description: Whether to collect funding opportunities or local vendors.

query.title: Query
query.description: Free-text query such as SME or tailor. Never used as a CSS selector or raw crawl URL.

businessCategory.title: Business category
businessCategory.description: Optional SME category used when searching for funding.

serviceCategory.title: Service category
serviceCategory.description: Vendor category: tailoring, bakery, shoemaker, printing or packaging. Required for vendor mode unless query is set.

state.title: State
state.description: Nigerian state. The first vendor source allowlists Lagos listing pages only.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: City, LGA or neighbourhood within the selected state, for example Ikeja or Yaba.

fundingType.title: Funding type
fundingType.description: Optional funding filter. Ignored when mode is vendors.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of valid records to push to the dataset. Default 5. Hard cap is 20.
